profile.headline: Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Strong engineering professional with a Master's of Science focused in Computer Science from California State University-Northridge.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a full-stack developer at Netflix, I've delivered web applications that support artists, overhead teams, and business stakeholders by partnering closely with stakeholders to understand and support workflows. Led the development of a critical web-based file publishing application, driving significant improvements in creative input ingestion for the pre-production pipeline. My current focus is as a full-stack developer on an artist and talent management platform, optimizing talent retention through recasting.

positions.title: Senior User Interface Engineer
positions.description: At Adobe, I architected and led the development of a modular API, significantly accelerating product deployment to over 20 surfaces (Web, iOS, and Desktop). Stepped into an interim Engineering Manager role, demonstrating strong leadership through project scoping, timeline creation, and facilitating critical team meetings with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: During two different tenures at Disney TVA, I led development of an ecosystem of internal web applications and services. Worked closely with a variety of business units and production crews to understand their needs and plan deliverables. Additionally, I led modernizing our development by collaborating with the team to introduce a SDLC, CI/CD, sprints, and various new tools.

projects.title: Electronic Assessment System
projects.description: Electronic system for the storage and evaluation of assessment material.  Acting scrummaster, coaching the project in its current development to pilot stage.
